subject: space-time and space-size modeling at the same time

messages.author: ef76f4ec1ca10943
messages.subject: space-time and space-size modeling at the same time
parts:
Hi,

I am trying to model the spatiotemporal distribution of a species by considering size as another dimension. 

We expect that the spatial distribution of similar sized individuals is similar, thus, in a purely spatial scenario I could do something like this:

sp_size = 1:10

In INLA:
s_index <- inla.spde.make.index('s', n.spde = spde$n.spde, n.group = max(sp_size ))
f(s, model = spde, group = s.group, control.group = list(model = 'ar1))

in inlabru:
field_S_size(coordinates, model=spde, group =  sp_size   , ngroup = max(sp_size ),control.group = list(model="ar1"))

where I would be linking the spatial distributions of sizes by an AR1 process.

But what if I want to add the temporal dimension through another AR1 process? would this be possible?

Cheers,
iosu
